description: This class implements a serializer for recurring deposit account business events, converting business events into Avro format using a mapper and a service to retrieve account data.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for converting recurring deposit account business events into Avro format, supporting schema retrieval and event serialization.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the given business event is of type RecurringDepositAccountBusinessEvent.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a RecurringDepositAccountBusinessEvent into its corresponding Avro DTO by retrieving account data and mapping it.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the specific Avro schema class supported by this serializer, RecurringDepositAccountDataV1.
